comment: The features ui-look.js shows, one entry each: what it is, its look steps and window test checks, and the settings and commands of package.json that belong to it. A feature the window cannot show says why in notInWindow. A feature that works through Agent Plus also names, under agentPlus, the settings, commands and views of Agent Plus's package.json it uses; agentPlusOther lists Agent Plus's other settings, commands and views, each with why it is not this extension's. test/parts/77-ui-look-features.js checks these lists against package.json and against the Agent Plus it finds, and the window test against the Agent Plus it installed.

features.what: Patching Codex's installed files at start-up, the prompt to reload, and Remove the Patch putting Codex's own files back until Turn On reapplies it
The work plan plugin installed into Codex, trust for its hooks, and the commands that install it again, download Python, trust the hooks and stop Codex loading it
The time every notification of Codex Plus starts with, in brackets, in the zone of the machine VS Code runs on once a Codex page has told it that zone, and with this machine's zone named until then
checks: the patch
